question: Will the temperature in NYC hit 13°C on Oct 17, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the temperature in New York City reaches or exceeds 13°C (55.4°F) at any point strictly after 2026-10-17T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-18T04:00:00Z, as recorded by an official weather station serving NYC.
- "No": Wins if the temperature in New York City does not reach 13°C (55.4°F) at any point strictly after 2026-10-17T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-18T04:00:00Z, as recorded by an official weather station serving NYC.

Clarifications:
- Temperature is measured as any observed (not forecast) reading at the primary official NYC surface observation station (Central Park / KNYC or the nearest available equivalent NWS station) during the window above; the criterion is satisfied if any single hourly or sub-hourly observation equals or exceeds 13°C (55.4°F).
